baslik: The New Dam That Failed While Filling

sahneler.metin: A brand-new dam failed before its reservoir was even full.
Water burst through the Teton Dam and flooded the valley below.
It was filling for the first time in June 1976.
Water had begun seeping through the dam.
It caused internal erosion, called piping.
Within hours, the dam was breached.
Eleven people died in the flood.
A new dam safety program then found other dangerous dams.

aciklama:
Teton Dam collapsed while its reservoir was filling for the first time. The cause: seepage through fissured rock and erodible wind-blown soil piping through the embankment.
